predictivehealthindicator.config.title: Predictive Health Indicator
predictivehealthindicator.config.categor: The general options of the mod.
predictivehealthindicator.config.enabled: Shows the estimated health above the head of every opponent.
predictivehealthindicator.config.through: The indicator stays visible through walls.
predictivehealthindicator.config.estimat: Estimate the damage of other players
Damage that comes from another player is estimated, so the indicator does not lose track of the health.
predictivehealthindicator.config.calibra: The death of an opponent and the totem that saves them show the real health, the damage is corrected with it.
predictivehealthindicator.config.debug.n: Show the numbers of the prediction
predictivehealthindicator.config.debug.d: Shows the inputs of the damage pipeline of every opponent, they help to find a wrong input.
predictivehealthindicator.config.update_: Once per launch the mod asks GitHub for the latest version and shows a dialog when a newer one is out. Nothing about you is sent. Off means no requests at all.
predictivehealthindicator.config.range.d: Opponents that are further away are not shown.
predictivehealthindicator.config.scale.d: One is the size of a vanilla name tag.
predictivehealthindicator.config.offset_: Shifts the indicator sideways, in blocks.
Shifts the indicator up and down, in blocks.
predictivehealthindicator.update.title: Predictive Health Indicator %s is out
predictivehealthindicator.update.message: You have %s. The new version is on its release page:
modmenu.summaryTranslation.predictivehea: Estimates your opponents' remaining health based on the damage you deal to them.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.predictiv: Estimates your opponents' remaining health based on the damage you deal to them.
